name: 37132 · Murfreesboro, TN
findings: ZIP 37132 (Murfreesboro) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
93% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Too few organizations for firm comparisons
observations.text: ZIP 37132 (Murfreesboro) has 14 organizations listing opportunities online, too few to compare reliably with similar places. Civic life here may run through churches, schools, local government, or informal groups that these records don't capture.

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 96% of all organizations here have no identified type.
